name: Assumption Test Card
deliverable: Scientific decomposition of hypotheses into verification tests and success thresholds

steps.text: Pick the assumption the plan depends on most and would hurt most if it turned out to be wrong.
Rewrite it as a hypothesis with a subject, a predicted behavior, and a measurable outcome.
Design the smallest test that could contradict the hypothesis, using people and tools the team already has.
Set the success threshold and the sample size before the test runs, so the result cannot be reinterpreted later.
Record the outcome and the decision it supports, then move to the next assumption or stop.

failure: A test that can only confirm: the team asks leading questions and counts enthusiasm as evidence, so the assumption survives untouched.
intervention: Ask what result would prove the assumption wrong, then design the test so that result could actually appear.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A common lean experimentation practice; no single documented originator.
